description: Defines a template class 'spsc_metric_report_channel' for a single-producer, single-consumer (SPSC) metric report channel using lock-free queues, internal object pooling, and customizable report construction and recycling.

classes.name: spsc_metric_report_channel
classes.description: A thread-safe, lock-free SPSC channel for reporting metrics with internal object pooling and customizable report handling.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Retrieves a report for writing if available, otherwise returns nullptr.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next report to be written without removing it from the queue.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the report buffer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of pending reports.

methods.name: get_next
methods.description: Obtains the next available report object from the free list, with fallback logging if depleted.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Marks a report as ready for processing, or recycles it if invalid.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Recycles a report after consumption, returning it to the free list.
